title: Arthur742Ramos/HigherLambdaModel
abstract: A Lean formalization of higher-dimensional structure in the untyped lambda calculus.  Arthur Ramos is the first author and responsible maintainer of the Lean formalization; Daniel O. Martinez-Rivillas and Ruy J.G.B. de Queiroz are credited as the mathematical/source authors whose results are formalized.  The Palomar surface uses a restricted Kan-complex exponential and a separate certificate for term-generated semantic bodies, while the substantive repository also formalizes the higher conversion tower and the concrete K-infinity homotopy lambda model.
